top_choice_rationale: P001 awards a single, identifiable invention: magic-wavelength lattice trapping of many neutral atoms (Katori), realised at uncertainties near 1e-18 (Ye) and reproduced independently in several laboratories. The two-name allocation is stable across all opening proposals and the citation can be scoped to the lattice scheme, separate from the 2005 comb and 2012 single-ion prizes. Its reach to redshift and constants tests supports the discovery-or-invention criterion, though the metrology overlap remains a real cost. P002 is a mature, reproduced prediction-then-observation arc, but its allocation is contested (Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang, Hasan) and it has a single supporter, so it ranks second ahead of no award.
recusal_note: No conflict for P001 or P002 apparent from profile; my own opening first choice (aberration-corrected TEM, B052) is outside the slate and no longer in play.
